headers:
Group D — application of the bidder's unit
price. Reference: Factor A Bid Form, Group
D — Unscheduled Events. Requested
response: Please confirm: (a) that the
$50,000.00 Group D annual figure is a City-
established allowance that is identical for all
bidders; (b) how the bidder's Group D unit
price will be used during contract
performance — for example, as the rate at
which unscheduled event work is drawn
down against the allowance; (c) the unit of
measure to which that price attaches (per
event, per crew hour, per site); and (d)
whether the Group D unit price is evaluated
under Factor A.

The $50,000 allowance is identical for all bidders.
Please refer to Factor A – 2027-0047 Bid Form –
Group D – Unscheduled Events. The bidder’s unit
price will be used for authorized Unscheduled Events
requested by the City during contract performance.
Charges for Unscheduled Events will be based on the
submitted Group D unit price and will be drawn from
the up to $50,000.00 annual budgeted amount.
Please refer to Attachment Factor A – 2027-0047 Bid
Form – Group D – Unscheduled Events. Unit of
measure is Per Visit.
Factor A is evaluated as the grand total and not per
group/line item.
sample:
Bid form Item 57 — missing site description.
Reference: Factor A Bid Form, Group A, Item
57; Attachment A — Locations List. Please
confirm the site name, address, receptacle
count and service frequency for Group A Item
57, and issue a corrected bid form by
amendment if appropriate.

Refer to Revised Factor A – 2027-0047 Bid Form for
added site item 57.

Receptacle count reconciliation. Reference:
Attachment A — Locations List; Factor A Bid
Form, Group A. - Attachment A states a total
of 2,751 receptacles. The sum of the per-site
receptacle counts on the line items is 2,758.
The difference of seven appears to relate to
the Hawkins site, which carries the annotation
"7 (Parks Only)." Please confirm the
controlling total receptacle count and clarify
the Hawkins annotation — specifically,
whether the seven receptacles noted as
"Parks Only" are included in or excluded from
the Group A requirement, and whether any
receptacles at that location are serviced under
a separate contract or by City forces.

The total number of trash cans for Group A is 2,758.
Refer to Revised Attachment A – Locations List.
